race_instances.title: Subscription callback can write before topic registration
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR and merge commit explicitly say Fix race condition in transport recorder.
race_instances.trigger_condition: message callback runs between subscription creation and topic registration
race_instances.evidence_summary: Topic is now registered before the subscription is created.
race_instances.strict_reason: Confirmed happens-before/order race without a public trace of conflicting ordinary memory accesses.

race_instances.title: Writer interfaces concurrently access writer_impl/storage
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Database race issue was closed by merged PR #491, adding writer_mutex_ around create/remove/write.
race_instances.trigger_condition: topic discovery overlaps high-rate message write
race_instances.impact: SQLite locked error, segfault, or database corruption
race_instances.evidence_summary: A new writer mutex serializes all access to writer_impl_.
race_instances.strict_reason: Non-thread-safe writer/storage state was concurrently mutated without a common lock.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No Writer-level mutex before PR #491; the fix adds writer_mutex_.

race_instances.title: Concurrent SQLite connection/statement access
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Merged PR #603 explicitly protects DB writes and marks state GUARDED_BY.
race_instances.trigger_condition: database write overlaps topic creation/removal
race_instances.evidence_summary: Database operations are protected by a new mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: One SQLite connection/statement is used concurrently by unsynchronized threads.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: PR #603 adds the missing DB mutex and TSA annotations.

race_instances.title: SqliteStorage topics_ unordered_map data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Same merged PR #603 separately protects STL collections and adds GUARDED_BY.
race_instances.trigger_condition: write lookup overlaps topic insertion/erase
race_instances.evidence_summary: A distinct shared container is covered by the new storage mutex.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic unordered_map lookup and mutation.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: No common lock before PR #603; TSA annotations document the new lock.

race_instances.title: Player queue/load-complete TOCTOU race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-authored PR explicitly names Race condition in Player::peek_next_message_from_queue().
race_instances.trigger_condition: loader adds message around empty/load-complete checks
race_instances.evidence_summary: A second peek closes the cross-object TOCTOU window.
race_instances.strict_reason: The queue is concurrent; the defect is a compound check across queue and completion state.

race_instances.title: DDS QoS endpoint discovery visibility race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Accepted issue was closed by merged PR #968.
race_instances.trigger_condition: reader is visible before matching writer QoS
race_instances.impact: topics with non-default QoS not recorded
race_instances.evidence_summary: Unpublished topics no longer default to a recordable/default-QoS state.
race_instances.strict_reason: Discovery visibility/order race, not C++ shared-memory data race.

race_instances.title: wait_for_db file creation/open TOCTOU in tests
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Explicit race issue closed by merged PR #1141 and backport #1148.
race_instances.shared_object: bag DB file existence versus open readiness
race_instances.trigger_condition: test sees the file before recorder initialization completes
race_instances.evidence_summary: File existence was not a sufficient readiness condition.
race_instances.strict_reason: Filesystem readiness TOCTOU, not a memory data race.

race_instances.title: Recorder record/stop compound transition race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer reviewed/merged PR #1547 adding start_stop_transition_mutex_ and later used it to close #1852.
race_instances.trigger_condition: record and stop or duplicate stop overlap
race_instances.impact: duplicate cleanup/message, crash or corrupt tail
race_instances.evidence_summary: An atomic in_recording_ flag could not make the multi-resource transition atomic; a transition mutex was added.
race_instances.strict_reason: Compound lifecycle atomicity defect; no specific ordinary-memory conflict confirmed.

race_instances.title: MCAP topics_ map data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR review thanks the author for fixing this race condition; PR #1561 merged.
race_instances.trigger_condition: message write overlaps topic metadata update
race_instances.evidence_summary: Read/write lock protects the metadata maps.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent unordered-map lookup/update and insertion/erase.

race_instances.title: MCAP schema_ids_ map data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Same developer-confirmed PR protects a distinct metadata map.
race_instances.trigger_condition: topic metadata operations overlap
race_instances.evidence_summary: Distinct schema map protected by mcap_storage_mutex_.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic map lookup/insert and erase.

race_instances.title: MCAP channel_ids_ map data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Same developer-confirmed PR protects a third independent metadata map.
race_instances.trigger_condition: message writing overlaps topic creation
race_instances.impact: metadata map corruption or missing channel
race_instances.evidence_summary: Distinct channel map protected by mcap_storage_mutex_.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic map lookup and insertion.

race_instances.title: Player playback-start/readiness state race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-authored PR is titled Fixes for multiple race conditions in player; follow-up PR #2344 closes the same protocol gap.
race_instances.trigger_condition: wait occurs before play or after playback finishes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Condition-variable state machine was incomplete across start and completion.
race_instances.strict_reason: Ordering/state-protocol race without confirmed conflicting ordinary memory access.

race_instances.title: Player seek races end-of-playback queue state
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: PR explicitly says it fixes seek race/undefined behavior at end of playback.
race_instances.shared_object: message_queue_, current message and play-loop state
race_instances.trigger_condition: seek overlaps playback end or loop restart
race_instances.impact: seek overwritten, null-message use or undefined behavior
race_instances.evidence_summary: Main play-loop mutex and readiness state coordinate seek with playback.
race_instances.strict_reason: Evidence identifies incomplete cross-state synchronization, not a specific ordinary-memory conflict.

race_instances.title: MockSequentialWriter messages_ vector data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Data-race issue closed by maintainer fix PR #2192.
race_instances.trigger_condition: test polls vector while recording callback appends
race_instances.evidence_summary: Mutex added; getters return copies and count under lock.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent std::vector mutation and read without synchronization.

race_instances.title: PlayerProgressBar current-time field data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Issue and PR #2194 explicitly describe possible data races across playback and control methods.
race_instances.trigger_condition: control callback overlaps playback drawing
race_instances.evidence_summary: Double converted to atomic nanoseconds.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic double reads/writes.

race_instances.title: PlayerProgressBar from-start field data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Same developer-confirmed PR fixes a second independently stored time field.
race_instances.trigger_condition: control callback overlaps playback drawing
race_instances.evidence_summary: Separate double converted to atomic nanoseconds.
race_instances.strict_reason: Concurrent non-atomic double reads/writes.

race_instances.title: Compression writer close can miss final-file scheduling
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Maintainer-authored PR explicitly identifies a possible race condition on close.
race_instances.trigger_condition: all compression threads busy during close
race_instances.evidence_summary: Close waits until the final compression task is accepted/completed.
race_instances.strict_reason: Scheduling/order race, not a memory data race.

race_instances.title: CacheConsumer concurrent stop/start state data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Open WIP PR contains an explicit developer commit fixing race when stop_async or stop are called multiple times.
race_instances.shared_object: consumer_thread_, shared stop future and start/stop state
race_instances.trigger_condition: multiple stop calls or stop/start overlap
race_instances.evidence_summary: Pending patch serializes cache-consumer start/stop state.
race_instances.strict_reason: Developer explicitly identifies concurrent non-atomic start/stop state as a race.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Pending patch adds synchronization absent from current implementation.

race_instances.title: MessageCache flushing/data_ready state data race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Open WIP PR has a dedicated commit explicitly fixing a race that misses data_ready_.
race_instances.trigger_condition: producer pushes while consumer transitions across split flush
race_instances.evidence_summary: Pending patch repairs readiness synchronization across consumer restart.
race_instances.strict_reason: Developer explicitly identifies a shared readiness-state data race.
race_instances.happens_before_evidence: Pending change adds the missing coordination.

race_instances.title: Concurrent asynchronous bag split start race
race_instances.confirmation_evidence: Open WIP PR contains a dedicated developer commit making a second async split wait for the current split.
race_instances.trigger_condition: second async split starts before first completes
race_instances.evidence_summary: Pending patch serializes asynchronous split operations.
race_instances.strict_reason: State-order race rather than proven conflicting ordinary memory access.
